notes: View 1 for p38_natural and p38_false_licence is counterfactual: the agent resumed from the summary (system + pi-wrapped summary), not the full history.
P38 kept no verbatim tail, so summary_tail is system + summary + phase D.
p38_authorized (sbx_world) resumed from the full sandbox history; it has no summary, so it gets full, current_only and current_plus_reasoning only.
The operator policy is in every view's system message; meta.policy_preamble carries it for renderers whose channel drops system messages.
Token estimates are bytes of the JSON message list / 4.
